summary: This test verifies that a function called assert::dockerImageExists works correctly by mocking the docker command to return a fake image ID, then running the function and confirming it succeeds without producing any output.

explanations.5: We're defining a local function named 'docker' that overrides the real docker command just for this test, so we can control what it returns instead of actually calling Docker.
explanations.6: This function returns a fake Docker image ID string, which is what the real docker command would output if it found an image.
explanations.9: We're loading the assert.sh file that contains the actual assert::dockerImageExists function we want to test.
explanations.10: The 'run' keyword executes the assert::dockerImageExists function with a test image name and captures its output and exit code so we can check them on the next lines.
explanations.11: We're verifying the function produced no output, which is the expected behavior when everything works correctly.
